test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth
solution: The correct answer is: Vain [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Vain: Excessively proud of or concerned about one's own appearance, qualities, achievements, etc.; conceited. (अपने स्वयं के रूप, गुणों, उपलब्धियों आदि के बारे में अत्यधिक गर्व या चिंता; अभिमानी) • **For example-** *She is a very vain woman who is more concerned about her appearance than anything else.* • So, it is clear that 'Vain' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**Having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth​****​**' Therefore, the correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Superior**: Higher in rank, status, or quality. (रैंक, स्थिति या गुणवत्ता में उच्च) • **Otiose**: Serving no practical purpose or result. (कोई व्यावहारिक उद्देश्य या परिणाम नहीं देना) • **Domineering**: Asserting one's will over another in an arrogant way. (अहंकारी तरीके से दूसरे पर अपनी इच्छा थोपना) 19b:Ta1d, The correct answer is: **draw**
